facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication Technologies' Mobile ID (E-Houwiya) FAQ describes a national digital identity in use for secure online login and electronic signature, free to Tunisian citizens aged 18 or over holding a national ID card.

The ministry's FAQ says Mobile ID login or e-signature is integrated in many government portals and platforms, listing 18 including e-cnam, the CNSS portal, the national business register, the tax administration's e-patente portal and the national administrative services portal.

The ministry's FAQ says citizens at home or abroad can bind Mobile ID to their phone through the E-Houwiya mobile app and use it to log in and sign documents electronically with the same legal value as a handwritten signature.
